title: TensorPlate Metric Event
description: Local metric sample envelope (V01-E12-F04). The v0.1 registry supports counters, gauges, and histograms; the wire form is the same for every kind so the local scrape/file/stdout sink can stream samples without per-kind branching. Label sets are bounded to keep cardinality finite on constrained devices.

name.description: Metric name. The `tp_` prefix is mandatory so an external scrape endpoint can distinguish TensorPlate metrics from host metrics without explicit namespacing.

kind.description: Aggregation kind. Counters are non-decreasing; gauges may go up and down; histograms carry a bounded list of bucket counts plus sum and count.

unit.description: Explicit unit. Producers MUST NOT use the same metric name with different units.

monotonic_timestamp_ns.description: Receiver-monotonic timestamp in nanoseconds. NEVER wall-clock.

priority.description: Optional delivery class, highest first: `fatal`, `safety`, `state`, `diagnostic`. It is independent of `kind`. A producer that sheds telemetry by class drops only `diagnostic` and does not treat an event without the field as `diagnostic`. A bounded queue that evicts by age does not read the field. A reader must not derive a class for an event that has none.

labels.description: Bounded label set. v0.1 allows the keys `endpoint`, `model_class`, `model_name`, `backend`, `component`, `status`, `row`, `mode`, `outcome`, `stage`. Values are bounded to 64 bytes, and the last four take only the values registered here. This schema holds only those four to their values and accepts any other key: the key set is enforced by the Rust mirror and by the registry, which reject an unknown key to keep cardinality finite. A session, turn, request or voice identifier is never a label.

row.description: Speech model row the series belongs to. Omitted for a deployment that is not one of the registered rows.

mode.description: Stream serving mode, as a bundle's speech block resolves it.

outcome.description: How the counted session or request ended. For this label `rejected` is a refusal before admission, and an expiry or a timeout is `failed`.

stage.description: Serving stage a duration covers, in pipeline order. `backend` is the whole backend job; a backend that cannot time its parts reports nothing finer.

sample.description: Sample payload. Counters and gauges set `value`; histograms set `bucket_upper_bounds`, `bucket_counts`, `count`, `sum`.

bucket_upper_bounds.description: Strictly increasing upper bounds in the metric's unit. The last bucket is implicit `+Inf`.

bucket_counts.description: Cumulative counts per bucket (matches the Prometheus exposition shape). Length must equal `len(bucket_upper_bounds) + 1`.

count.description: Total observation count (histograms only). Must match the final implicit +Inf bucket count.

correlation_id.description: Optional bounded correlation id carried as a sample-level exemplar.
